decisions.note: changed FR-01.05.AC09: "Given an assistant is about to run a command, when that command would overwrite the shared main branch's history by force, then it is stopped; any other comm..." -> "Given an assistant is about to run a command, when that command would overwrite the shared main branch's history by force, then it is stopped; any other comm..."

items.new_text: Given an assistant is about to run a command, when that command would overwrite the shared main branch's history by force, then it is stopped; any other command, including one that only mentions it, runs untouched. When the precise check cannot reach a decision, a coarser fallback applies that errs towards stopping a forced push that mentions the main branch, rather than letting one through.
items.old_text: Given an assistant is about to run a command, when that command would overwrite the shared main branch's history by force, then it is stopped; any other command, including one that only mentions it, runs untouched, and a failure of this protection never blocks work.
